mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS productId, p.sku, p.name, 1.0 AS score FROM warehouse.products p WHERE p.is_active = TRUE AND ( p.part_number_normalized IN #{n} OR NULLIF(regexp_replace(upper(p.sku), '[ .\-]', '', 'g'), '') IN #{n} ) ORDER BY p.name LIMIT 5

SELECT p.id AS productId, p.sku, p.name, public.similarity(p.name, #{name}) AS score FROM warehouse.products p WHERE p.is_active = TRUE AND public.similarity(p.name, #{name}) > #{threshold} ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warehouse.supplier_products (supplier_id, supplier_sku, product_id, name_snapshot, last_unit_price_excl_vat, last_seen_at) VALUES (#{supplierId}, #{supplierSku}, #{productId}, #{nameSnapshot}, #{lastUnitPriceExclVat}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (supplier_id, supplier_sku) DO UPDATE SET product_id = EXCLUDED.product_id, name_snapshot = EXCLUDED.name_snapshot, last_unit_price_excl_vat = EXCLUDED.last_unit_price_excl_vat, last_seen_at = NOW()
